order: Fix a silent agent-load failure affecting the cross-vendor pack's three agent definitions. Diagnose why the harness silently drops these agents instead of raising an error: a bare colon-space sequence inside an unquoted description field makes the frontmatter unparseable, and the harness's own repair pass cannot recover it when the file was checked out with Windows line endings. Fix each of the three affected agent files with a minimal, one-word rewording of the offending description text — do not restructure the frontmatter or quote the field, since a small wording change is enough to eliminate the bare colon and restore parseability without touching any other part of the file. Keep the fix scoped to exactly the three files that silently failed to load; do not touch unrelated pack definitions.
claims: We traced the silent agent-load failure to a bare colon-space sequence inside an unquoted description field, which the harness's frontmatter repair pass cannot fix under a Windows-line-ending checkout. A one-word rewording in each of the three affected files removes the bare colon and restores parseability, for three insertions and three deletions total. We confirmed the frontmatter now parses for all three agent definitions.
